points.description: States that searching a node in a BST takes a number of steps equal to the height of the tree (O(h), at most the height / proportional to the height).
points.partial_credit: Part marks (about 2-3) for a vague or partly wrong statement, e.g. only 'depends on the depth/levels of the tree' or 'log n' without linking to height; no marks for answers like 'one step' or 'n steps' with no reference to height.

rubric.notes: Full marks for saying the steps equal (or are proportional to / at most) the height of the tree, in any wording, including O(h). Part marks for a related but vague or slightly wrong statement, such as mentioning depth or levels without clearly tying it to height, or giving log n without mentioning height. No marks for answers that do not relate the steps to the tree's height, e.g. a constant number or n with no explanation.
